test_GIL_deadlock_single_thread: test that pybind11 GIL scoped callback does not deadlock when running in a single thread
test_GIL_deadlock_parallel_threads: test that pybind11 GIL scoped callback does not deadlock across 8 parallel threads
test_GIL_deadlock_sequential_threads: test that pybind11 GIL scoped callback does not deadlock across 8 sequential threads
test_GIL_deadlock_multiprocess: test that pybind11 GIL scoped callback does not deadlock when running in a separate process
test_cross_module_GIL_acquire: test that the GIL can be acquired by another module from a GIL-released state
